definitions.supplemental: Cf. Goth. glitmunjan: O. H. Ger. glizinon.

quotations.old_english: Heó glytenode on ðæra engla mydle swá scýnende sunne
quotations.english: she glittered amid the angels as the shining sun

source_text: glitinian, glitenian; p. ode; pp. od To glitter, glisten, shine :-- Geseah gold glitinian he saw gold glisten, Beo. Th. 5509; B. 2758. Heó glytenode on ðæra engla mydle swá scýnende sunne she glittered amid the angels as the shining sun, Shrn. 149, 7. His reáf wurdon glitiniende vestimenta ejus facta sunt splendentia, Mk. Skt. 9, 3. [Cf. Goth. glitmunjan: O. H. Ger. glizinon.]
